shortDescription: The FTSE 100 Index dropped 32 points or 0.30 percent on Tuesday to close at 10792 points.Losses were led by Endeavour (-5.80%), Fresnillo (-5.33%) and Antofagasta (-5.22%).Offsetting the fall, top gainers were BP (5.66%), Reckitt Benckiser (4.68%) and Rentokil Initial (3.17%).

children: The FTSE 100 Index dropped 32 points or 0.30 percent on Tuesday to close at 10792 points.
Losses were led by Endeavour (-5.80%), Fresnillo (-5.33%) and Antofagasta (-5.22%).
Offsetting the fall, top gainers were BP (5.66%), Reckitt Benckiser (4.68%) and Rentokil Initial (3.17%).

title: The FTSE 100 Index Closes 0.30% Lower
